classification.difficultyReason: Calculate the usable rectangular box volume and subtract the explicitly stated occupied vase volume.

content.prompt:
A vase with a volume of $200\ \mathrm{cm}^3$ is packed into the cardboard box shown below.
The space around the vase is filled with packing foam. What is the volume of the foam?

spec.description: Unfilled open box, front flap projecting down-left and rear flap extending up-right; opening rim and inner rear upright remain distinct. Ordinary source-blue edges rendered black.

Front and right walls are explicit quadrilaterals; front flap DCQP and rear flap HGSR are separate faces with unspecified physical flap dimensions. Front flap occludes the upper portion of the front-left wall edge. Opening edges DH, HG and GC and the visible inner segment HJ are retained separately. No vase, foam or hidden-edge dashes added.
